interpretation_limits: Pixel equality and complete evidence do not automatically demonstrate a performance improvement.
Each timing summary uses independent process runs; within-run medians are reduced before the cross-run median and range.
Three runs support a median and observed range, not a reliable p95 or a universal speedup claim.
Application caches start fresh; identity hashing reads source files before timing, so this is not cold-disk measurement.
Natural cadence means 1500 ms of host idle after a completed checkpoint; preparation, paint checks, and input add time.
Scripted rapid intents share the UI thread with real software drawing; nominal 40 ms is not fixed external arrival cadence.
Rapid published survivors are not all four request latencies; the full burst endpoint and publication counts are separate.
Reader preparation, worker envelopes, and nested stage profiles overlap and must not be added as independent totals.
Prepared-frame retention or cancelled prediction work does not count as a hit; only prepared_frame_hit does.
Cover overlap is pairwise intersection of traced worker wall envelopes, not proof of simultaneous CPU execution.
Cover worker and UI callback observations are recomputed from raw regular/speculative timestamp pairs; absent or incomplete pairs remain null.
Cover UI callback totals include callback state work and are not an isolated image-copy stage.
A high-resolution cover after idle proves availability, not that admission occurred exclusively during idle.
Scribe denotes design geometry only; no physical panel, native SEND, release-build latency, or peak RSS was measured.
privacy: Only fixed workload labels, numeric diagnostics, and hashes; no source content, screenshots, reading metadata, private paths, or logs
